purpose: Check whether cheap CLIP retrieval confidence can select 16-vs-64-frame VideoITG before the expensive call
cheap_signal: B0 Top-1 score or Top-1 minus Top-2 margin
fallback_target: Use B1 max_frames=64 output for selected rows; otherwise B1 16-frame output
train_dev_result: No selective threshold was supported: B0 score thresholds are either nearly empty or select almost all rows, while B0 margin thresholds select all rows above the first few cut points; dev has only 8 rows and no discriminating quality signal.
reason: The B0 signal cannot reduce 64-frame calls while retaining a train/dev-supported quality benefit. Keep fixed B1 default and the static 64-frame candidate; do not claim a dynamic policy.
